urls.rationale: General definitions used throughout Ch. 25, including 'lobbyist', 'principal', 'thing of value', etc.
Section 36-25-1.1 (Lobbying) — lobbying-specific scope and definitions provision.
Section 36-25-5.1 — limitations on actions of lobbyists, subordinates of lobbyists, and principals (gift/contact rules).
Section 36-25-18 — registration of lobbyists required; filing of supplemental registration (core registration provision).
Section 36-25-19 — registered lobbyists and other persons required to file quarterly reports (core activity-reporting provision).
Section 36-25-20 — filing of notice of termination of lobbying activities; effect on reporting requirement.
Section 36-25-21 — lobbyist reports constitute public records; available for public inspection (core disclosure provision).
Section 36-25-22 — scope clause for §§36-25-18 through 36-25-21 (registration/reporting professional-services carve-out).
Section 36-25-23 — lobbying activities prohibited during elected term; floor privileges; solicitation; contingency-fee lobbying contracts.
Section 36-25-26 — false reporting for purpose of influencing legislation (lobbying-report integrity provision).
Section 36-25-27 — penalties, enforcement, jurisdiction, judicial review, limitations period for chapter violations including lobbying provisions.

notes: Ch. 25 exposes per-section leaves (Wisconsin-style convention). General-ethics sections (§§36-25-3 through 36-25-17) excluded as outside lobbying-disclosure scope (Ethics Commission admin, conflicts of interest, statement of economic interests for officials/candidates, etc.). §36-25-1.2 is repealed. §36-25-1.3 (Economic Development Professionals) is a parallel registration regime for non-lobbyist economic-development liaisons and may warrant inclusion depending on downstream rubric — excluded here as not strictly 'lobbying' disclosure. §36-25-24 (whistleblower retaliation) excluded. §§36-25-28-30 (savings clause, appropriations, construction) excluded as not part of statute body.
